comment: Bot-free live input proof on Larak Lot from the first spawn slot (TOLL north). No teleport, no jump during stair walking. Run with FRAGR_QA_BOTS=0, FRAGR_QA_NO_ROUND_EVENTS=1, and FRAGR_QA_MANIFEST=res://qa/movement.json.

states.name: jump_input
states.note: Sub-frame Space tap rises and lands through actual input, server, and camera.

states.name: stair_approach
states.note: Cross the Toll plaza and walk down the west stair into the Lane.

states.name: outer_stair_top
states.note: Walk the Lane lip and up the Toll Steps' half-metre treads without jumping.

states.name: inner_stair_bottom
states.note: Cross the Bridge over the Pit to the Crane landing and walk down into the Impound.

states.name: inner_stair_top
states.note: Walk up the nine treads of Stair B to the Roof.

states.name: ledge_exit
states.note: Walk off the Roof's south edge, land on the Crane landing, and keep moving beyond the inflated edge.
